title: Shinonome Akito — Burnout〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Early morning
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We aren't supposed to meet for a good while.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess I haven't been able to stay still since hearing about going over to the US yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: America, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was honestly pretty surprised when we got that invitation. It was so sudden.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is the USA we're talking about. I'm going.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I couldn't think of any other way to respond to Taiga's message...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I mean, that's probably because...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I couldn't say no after hearing that guy sing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Beyond our dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND... What does that world look like...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I want to see for myself.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The way he sang filled me with that desire.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have no idea if I'll find that special something KAITO was talking about in the US...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I do know that I want to see the world. So...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (All that's left for me to do is trust my gut and keep going where I think I should.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright. We're not meeting for a while yet...
But I guess I can start warming up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Maybe some light stretches—
Good morning, Akito.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya... You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but later than you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's partly because I can't contain my excitement after receiving Taiga's invitation...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But more than that, hearing the way you sang yesterday filled me with a desire to sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, wanna start a little early?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that.
What? You guys are already here?!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I was so sure that we'd get here first today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like we were wrong.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You two are also here really early today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I got up way earlier than usual for some reason. Hearing that incredible singing yesterday may've played a role.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it's not like there was anything to do at home, so I decided to come here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. I also left early because I wanted to sing as soon as possible. An and I ran into each other along the way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Neither of us expected to see each other at this time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, we started talking about being the first ones here. But to our surprise, you guys had already arrived.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It sounds to me that we're all feeling the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since we're all here, why don't we start practice early today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If we're serious about standing on top of the world, then we don't have a minute or second to waste...

rows.Speaker: An, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And to make sure we get to stand on top of the world together...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I need to put in even more effort.)
